entities.summary: Aulcie Perry is a retired American-Israeli professional basketball player. He helped Maccabi Tel Aviv win two EuroLeague championships, during his nine seasons with the team. During his playing career, he was listed at 2.08 m tall, and 98 kg (216 lb) in weight, and he played at the center position.
